theory: State k≠0 for the exponential-curve and never-reaches-the-asymptote claims: k=0 gives the constant line y=c. Qualify the statement that replacing x with -x turns growth into decay with a>1; for 0<a<1 it turns decay into growth. These are local qualifications; the supplied items' calculations and methods remain valid.
